title: The whore of the lane!
html_source: Bloom also sees the “whore of the lane” wearing the black straw Sailor hat in Chapter 16, “Eumaeus”.

anchor.prefix: e a prayer, drop a tear. All the same he must have been a bit of a natural not to see it was a yeoman cap. Muffled up. Wonder who was that chap at the grave in the brown macin. O,
anchor.suffix: A frowsy whore with black straw sailor hat askew came glazily in the day along the quay towards Mr Bloom. When first he saw that form endearing? Yes, it is. I feel so lonely. W
